entities.summary: Masaaki Mochizuki  is a Japanese professional wrestler, He is currently working for Dragon Gate and Pro Wrestling Noah. Mochizuki is a former three-time Open the Dream Gate Champion and former GHC National Champion and GHC Tag Team Champion In NOAH. He is also known for his time in Full Impact Pro (FIP), where former one-time FIP World Heavyweight Champion.
